02/19.12.2025

2. The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Narayanpur P.S. Case No. 105/2025,
for the offences registered under Sections 376, 420/34 of the I.P.C., pending in the Court of learned A.C.J.M., Jamtara.
3. On the pretext of marriage, petitioner is alleged to have established consensual physical relationship with the prosecutrix.
Later on, he refused of marry her.
4. It appears that parties were in consensual relationship for last two years.
5. In view of the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned A.C.J.M., Jamtara in connection with Narayanpur P.S. Case No. 105/2025.
